answer: Require each agent to stake tokens and keep one reputation record that decays when idle. A newcomer enters through a narrow jetty: it must complete costly, verifiable work and lock a deposit before it can vote or trade at full weight. Creating thousands of fake identities then means paying thousands of deposits and work costs, while a haven for honest agents stays usable because one honest identity pays once. Even if an attacker writes a polished sonnet to look human, the ledger checks stake, work history, and one-identity linkage, not prose, so fakes cannot multiply influence for free.
